title: Comprehensive epigenomic profiling of human alveolar epithelial differentiation identifies key epigenetic states and transcription factor co-regulatory networks for maintenance of distal lung identity
overall_design: RNA was isolated from 1 million cells for each timepoint using the GE triplePrep kit. RiboZero depletion was used as well as DNaseI to ensure RNA quality prior to library preparation. Library preparation was performed at the USC Epigenome Core. Barcodes used for multiplexed sequencing are indicated in the filename for each sample. Reads underwent paired-end sequencing and were aligned back to the hg19 genome. DNA was isolated from the same cells as RNA using the GE triplePrep kit. DNA underwent bisulfite treatment and sequencing at the USC Epigenome Core. Reads were mapped back to the bisulfite hg19 genome. BisSNP was used for SNP calling and generation of methylation calls. MethylSeekR was used for methylation domain calling. Chromatin immunoprecipitation was performed using antibodies against H3K27ac (Cat # 39133, Active Motif, Carlsbad CA), H3K4me1 (pAb-037-050, Diagenode, Denville NJ), CTCF (Cat #2899, Cell Signaling, Danvers MA), H3K27me3 (#07-449) and H3K9/14Ac (#06-599) from Millipore (Burlington, MA) and the Imprint Ultra Chromatin Immunoprecipitation Kit (Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis MO). Enrichment was verified at the previously identified GRAMD2 enhancer region prior to Next-generation sequencing library construction. Human GRAMD2 enhancer primer sequence: Forward 5’-GGT CTC CTG ATT TCC TGA TG -3’, Reverse 5’-AGG CTG ACT TCT CAC TAT TC-3’. FAIRE libraries were generated from the histone-depleted supernatants. Free DNA was isolated using an established protocol. Samples underwent library preparation and single end (SE) 50-cycle DNA sequencing using an Illumina HiSeq2000 (Illumina, San Diego CA) at the USC Epigenome Center (USC, Los Angeles CA).

growth_protocol_ch1: Primary AT2 cells were extracted as described previously and differentiated in vitro for six days (Marconett et al., PLoS Genetics, 2013).
extract_protocol_ch1: DNA, RNA, and ChIP material were prepared as previously published (Zuber et al., JNCI, 2016).
Library construction was performed at the USC Epigenome Center core, as previously described (Zuber et al., JNCI, 2016).

data_processing: For DNA, Fastq files were aligned to the bisulfite hg19 genome by the USC Epigenome Center core. For RNA and ChIPseq, Reads were aligned to the canonical Hg19 genome using Bowtie 2.

For ChIPseq, peaks were called using SICER with gap spacing of 600 for H3K27me3 and H3K79me2, gap spacing of 200 for other marks. treatment_protocol_ch1: Purified DNA underwent bisulfite treatment as described previously (Zuber et al., JNCI, 2016). RNA underwent polyA selection and library preparation as previously described (Zuber at al., 2016). ChIP material underwent adapter ligation, library preparation, and multiplexed sequencing as previously described (Zuber et al., 2016).
growth_protocol_ch1: Primary AT2 cells were extracted as described previously and differentiated in vitro for six days (Marconett et al., PLoS Genetics, 2013).
extract_protocol_ch1: DNA, RNA, and ChIP material were prepared as previously published (Zuber et al., JNCI, 2016).
Library construction was performed at the USC Epigenome Center core, as previously described (Zuber et al., JNCI, 2016).

WGBS Indexes were included on Donor 1 samples. Donor 1 D0 Index : TGACCA, Donor 1 D2 Index: CAGTG, Donor 1 D4 Index: GCCAAT, Donor 1 D6 Index: CAGATC. ChIPseq samples were multiplexed on Illumina HiSeq2000 lanes, the indicated adapters on FASTQ files were used to de-multiplex.
data_processing: For DNA, Fastq files were aligned to the bisulfite hg19 genome by the USC Epigenome Center core. For RNA and ChIPseq, Reads were aligned to the canonical Hg19 genome using Bowtie 2.

For DNA, Bis-SNP was used for methylation and SNPtype calling (Liu et al., Genome Biology, 2012). For RNA, TopHat2 was used to assemble transcripts using Gencode. For ChIPseq, peaks were called using SICER with gap spacing of 600 for H3K27me3 and H3K79me2, gap spacing of 200 for other marks. MACS2 was also used to call enhancer regions for ROADMAP/ENCODE comparisons.
Genome_build: hg19 (GRCh37)
